note: The field overrides of one collection group, as three different tools report them, beside the database default. First observed 2026-09-20 against a standard Firestore-native database, for issue #53. Verbatim except for the project id, which is the placeholder `demo-fixtures`. Regenerate with `scripts/capture-live-fields.mjs`, which records under `source` how each rendering was read back and which configurations the database refused; `note` and `observations` are the parts it leaves to a maintainer.

source.project: demo-fixtures (placeholder; the observation was made against a disposable project)

configured.tags: already listed before this run, not configured by it; assumed configured as: v1.FirestoreAdminClient.updateField({"field":{"name":"projects/demo-fixtures/databases/(default)/collectionGroups/probe_fields/fields/tags","indexConfig":{"indexes":[{"queryScope":"COLLECTION_GROUP","fields":[{"fieldPath":"tags","arrayConfig":"CONTAINS"}]},{"queryScope":"COLLECTION","fields":[{"fieldPath":"tags","order":"ASCENDING"}]}]}},"updateMask":{"paths":["index_config"]}})
configured.body: already listed before this run, not configured by it; assumed configured as: gcloud firestore indexes fields update body --collection-group=probe_fields --disable-indexes --project demo-fixtures --database '(default)'

ttl.command: gcloud firestore fields ttls update expiresAt --collection-group=probe_fields --enable-ttl --project demo-fixtures --database '(default)' --async
ttl.stderr: ERROR: (gcloud.firestore.fields.ttls.update) PERMISSION_DENIED: Project demo-fixtures has billing disabled. Please enable it.

readBack.liveByAdminClient: v1.FirestoreAdminClient.listFieldsAsync({ parent: 'projects/demo-fixtures/databases/(default)/collectionGroups/-', filter: 'indexConfig.usesAncestorConfig=false OR ttlConfig:*' }, { autoPaginate: false }), constructed with and without `fallback: true`; the two listings were compared equal
readBack.liveByGcloud: gcloud firestore indexes fields list --format=json --project demo-fixtures --database '(default)'

observations.defaultIsListedUnderTheFilter: The filter `indexConfig.usesAncestorConfig=false OR ttlConfig:*` returns `__default__/*` beside the overrides: it owns its configuration by definition, so the first half of the filter admits it. It holds exactly ASCENDING, DESCENDING and CONTAINS at COLLECTION scope, which is the set `overrides.ts` checks it against. This is the observation the `default-changed` refusal and the by-name exclusion rest on.
observations.exemptionArrivesWithNoIndexes: The exempted field `body` lists with `indexes: []` through the admin client and with no `indexes` key at all through gcloud, `usesAncestorConfig` false (filled in by the client, omitted by gcloud). So an absent set on a field that owns its configuration is an exemption, and `readLiveField` reads it as one. The Firebase CLI exports it as `indexes: []`.
observations.nestedDensityIsUnspecified: Every nested index lists `density: DENSITY_UNSPECIFIED` — unlike a composite index, which the same database stamps SPARSE_ALL (see `live-indexes.json`). `COMPARABLE_DENSITIES` has to hold both, and the two fixtures together are why.
observations.nestedIndexesAreNameless: A nested index carries `name: ""` through the admin client and no `name` through gcloud. The readiness gate keys on names, which is why `liveSingleFieldIndexes` makes one from the field's name and the index's scope and direction.
observations.collectionGroupScopeNeedsTheApi: `gcloud firestore indexes fields update --index` accepts `order` and `array-config` only; a `COLLECTION_GROUP` single-field index can be configured through the admin API (`updateField`, recorded under `source.configured.tags`) or the Firebase CLI's deploy. The `snake_case` mask `index_config` was accepted first time.
observations.ttlNotObserved: TTL is a billed feature and the disposable project has billing disabled; the refusal is recorded verbatim under `source.refusals.ttl`. So this fixture does not carry a TTL-only field, and the claim `overrides.ts` makes about one — that it lists with `usesAncestorConfig: true` and the inherited set materialised, which is why the CLI's `ttl: true` declaration with the three defaults written out reconciles — rests on the Firebase CLI's source (`src/firestore/api.ts`, which reads `indexConfig.indexes` of every field the filter returns) and not on a listing. Re-observe against a billed project when one is available.
observations.renderingsDiffer: Only the admin client fills in the proto3 defaults — `usesAncestorConfig`, `reverting`, `apiScope`, `density`, `name`, `multikey`, `shardCount`, `unique`, and `ttlConfig: null` — and gcloud omits them all, including `usesAncestorConfig: false` on an override. The Firebase CLI writes `ttl: false` explicitly and drops `__default__/*`. `readLiveField` therefore reads an absent `usesAncestorConfig` as ownership, and both renderings reconcile identically against the CLI's declaration (`overrides.test.js`).
